profile.name: Newport 1830C 光功率计
profile.description: 用于测量光信号功率的台式光功率计，可进行波长补偿、量程设置、零点扣除、参考值存储和自动校准，适合激光与光学实验中的功率监测与定量测量。
profile.description_en: A benchtop optical power meter for measuring optical signal power. It supports wavelength compensation, range selection, zero subtraction, reference storage, and auto calibration, making it suitable for power monitoring and quantitative measurements in laser and optics experiments.
